facts.title: chilaquiles brunch casserole
ingredients: 12 small (6-inch) corn tortillas, quartered and fried until crisp
1 1/4 cups (from a 10-ounce can) red enchilada sauce [see Note]
1 3/4 cups (from a 15-ounce can) black beans, drained and rinsed
2 cups (8 ounces) coarsely grated shredded monterey jack or cheddar cheese
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
Thinly sliced scallions, sour cream, diced avocado, and hot sauce, to finish and serve
facts.author: Deb Perelman
